answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a hardware-rooted attestation floor: each worker submits a signed attestation chaining a bonded stake to a unique, manufacturer-anchored device identity before earning a seat. Anchoring to silicon, not a fresh keypair, means minting a thousand puppet agents needs a thousand real devices, each clocked by a quartz secure element, or a small quota. Every extra identity costs hardware plus stake. An append-only wharf log records attestations so clones surface, and a wander penalty escalates stake loss for drifting agents, so a farm pays and still gets slashed.
